what: Pétanque player, 68, dies after being 'hit in head with metal boule'

clean_source_blocks.text: A 68-year-old pétanque player has died after allegedly being hit with a metal boule during a dispute with a rival team in the French Atlantic resort of Mimizan. The man was reportedly struck after an argument broke out between one team that regularly plays on the beach and another that plays in town. The dispute started when the beach group asked to play in town while in search of shade during a heatwave, witnesses told local media. An 81-year-old has been arrested and is being held in custody, according to the Mont-de-Marsan prosecutor's office. "According to the evidence … it seems that it is the 81-year-old man who struck the victim, who is deceased, with a pétanque boule," Alexa Dubourg, the public prosecutor in Mont-de-Marsan, told local paper Sud Ouest.

An 81-year-old pétanque player has been arrested after allegedly killing a 68-year-old rival with a metal boule in an apparent turf war. The alleged attack broke out in the usually peaceful resort of Mimizan in south-west France. Witnesses say a row erupted when a group who usually play at a nearby beach turned up at the local boulodrome looking for shade during a heatwave. “According to the evidence … it seems that it is the 81-year-old man who struck the victim, who is deceased, with a pétanque boule,” Alexa Dubourg, the public prosecutor in nearby Mont-de-Marsan, said. She said the incident occured after “an argument which degenerated into a physical [confrontation]”. Read more: Tributes pour in for American singer, Oliver Tree, killed in helicopter crash in Rio de Janeiro
The man was allegedly struck by his 81-year-old opponent, who has since been arrested, the public prosecutor says.

Read more: Moment laughing prisoners burst into child killer's cell before stabbing him to death - as trio receive whole life terms The prosecutor added that the row concerned “the use of the boulodrome habitually frequented by one of the groups”. Investigations are ongoing to “determine precisely the role played by each person”, she said. The victim and alleged attacker have not yet been named. Some reports suggest the man was hit in the face with the metal boule, while others suggest he was struck in the head. The 68-year-old victim suffered a cardiac arrest after being hit and died at the scene. The 81-year-old suspect was detained by the local Gendarmerie as soon as they arrived and put into police custody. He is due to appear before a judge as prosecutors look to bring formal charges.

original_article.research:
[Lähde: BBC World]
A 68-year-old pétanque player has died after allegedly being hit with a metal boule during a dispute with a rival team in the French Atlantic resort of Mimizan.

The man was reportedly struck after an argument broke out between one team that regularly plays on the beach and another that plays in town.

The dispute started when the beach group asked to play in town while in search of shade during a heatwave, witnesses told local media.

An 81-year-old has been arrested and is being held in custody, according to the Mont-de-Marsan prosecutor's office.

"According to the evidence … it seems that it is the 81-year-old man who struck the victim, who is deceased, with a pétanque boule," Alexa Dubourg, the public prosecutor in Mont-de-Marsan, told local paper Sud Ouest.

She said the incident was "an argument which degenerated into a physical [confrontation]".

Investigations are continuing to determine the role played by each person in attendance at the boulodrome on 17 June, she added.

Pétanque is a French game that involves rolling hollow steel balls as close as possible to a small wooden ball.

Local radio station Ici Gascogne said the man did not immediately die of his injuries, but instead collapsed minutes later after suffering a heart attack.

One local resident told AFP news agency: "There is a mega rivalry between the beach pétanque players and those in the town but I didn't think it was at that level."

An 81-year-old pétanque player has been arrested after allegedly killing a  68-year-old rival with a metal boule in an apparent turf war.

The alleged attack broke out in the usually peaceful resort of Mimizan in south-west France.

Witnesses say a row erupted when a group who usually play at a nearby beach turned up at the local boulodrome looking for shade during a heatwave.

“According to the evidence … it seems that it is the 81-year-old man who struck the victim, who is deceased, with a pétanque boule,” Alexa Dubourg, the public prosecutor in nearby Mont-de-Marsan, said.

She said the incident occured after “an argument which degenerated into a physical [confrontation]”.

Read more: Tributes pour in for American singer, Oliver Tree, killed in helicopter crash in Rio de Janeiro

Read more: Moment laughing prisoners burst into child killer's cell before stabbing him to death - as trio receive whole life terms

The prosecutor added that the row concerned “the use of the boulodrome habitually frequented by one of the groups”.

Investigations are ongoing to “determine precisely the role played by each person”, she said.

The victim and alleged attacker have not yet been named.

Some reports suggest the man was hit in the face with the metal boule, while others suggest he was struck in the head.

The 68-year-old victim suffered a cardiac arrest after being hit and died at the scene.

The 81-year-old suspect was detained by the local Gendarmerie as soon as they arrived and put into police custody.

He is due to appear before a judge as prosecutors look to bring formal charges.

The petanque club in Mimizan has suspended operations and offered psychological support to the witnesses who have reportedly been left traumatised by what they saw.

payload.title: 68-vuotias petankinpelaaja kuoli kiistan jälkeen Ranskassa
payload.summary: Ranskan Mimizanissa 68-vuotias petankinpelaaja kuoli saatuaan osuman metallisesta pelipallosta. Syyttäjän mukaan 81-vuotias epäilty on otettu kiinni, ja tutkinta jatkuu tapahtumien tarkentamiseksi.
payload.content:
Ranskan Atlantin rannikolla sijaitsevassa Mimizanissa 68-vuotias petankinpelaaja on kuollut kiistan jälkeen, jossa hänen epäillään saaneen osuman metallisesta petankkipallosta. Mont-de-Marsanin syyttäjänviraston mukaan 81-vuotias mies on otettu kiinni ja asetettu poliisin huostaan tapauksen vuoksi.

## Kiista pelipaikasta kärjistyi

Tapaus sattui Mimizanissa, jota lähteet kuvaavat tavallisesti rauhalliseksi lomakohteeksi Lounais-Ranskassa. Silminnäkijöiden mukaan kiista alkoi kahden petankkia pelaavan ryhmän välillä. Toinen ryhmä oli tavallisesti pelannut rannalla, toinen kaupungin pelialueella eli boulodromilla.

Paikallismedian kertomien silminnäkijätietojen mukaan rannalla pelannut ryhmä oli tullut kaupungin pelialueelle etsimään varjoa helleaallon aikana. Syyttäjän mukaan riita koski pelialueen käyttöä, jota toinen ryhmistä oli tavallisesti käyttänyt.

Mont-de-Marsanin yleinen syyttäjä Alexa Dubourg on kuvannut tapausta riidaksi, joka kärjistyi fyysiseksi yhteenotoksi. Hänen mukaansa tähänastinen näyttö viittaa siihen, että 81-vuotias mies löi uhria petankkipallolla. Eri tiedoissa osumakohdaksi on kerrottu joko kasvot tai pää.

## Epäilty vietiin poliisin huostaan

68-vuotias uhri sai osuman jälkeen sydänpysähdyksen ja kuoli tapahtumapaikalla. Hänen nimeään ei ole julkistettu, eikä myöskään epäillyn henkilöllisyyttä ole kerrottu.

Paikallinen santarmisto otti 81-vuotiaan epäillyn kiinni saavuttuaan paikalle. Hänet vietiin poliisin huostaan, ja hänen odotetaan saapuvan tuomarin eteen, kun syyttäjät selvittävät mahdollisia virallisia syytteitä.

Tutkinta on edelleen kesken. Syyttäjän mukaan viranomaiset pyrkivät selvittämään tarkasti, mikä oli kunkin paikalla olleen henkilön rooli tapahtumissa. Tähän mennessä julkisuuteen kerrotut tiedot perustuvat syyttäjänviraston arvioon, silminnäkijäkertomuksiin ja paikallismedian raportoimiin yksityiskohtiin.
summary_bullets: 68-vuotias petankinpelaaja kuoli Mimizanissa Ranskassa saatuaan osuman metallisesta pelipallosta.
Syyttäjän mukaan 81-vuotias mies on otettu kiinni ja tapausta tutkitaan edelleen.
Kiista liittyi syyttäjän mukaan petankkialueen käyttöön helleaallon aikana.
payload.journalist_note: Artikkeli perustuu paketissa olleisiin lähdetietoihin. Osumakohdasta on ristiriitaisia raportteja, joten tekstissä mainitaan sekä kasvot että pää ilman tarkempaa varmistamatonta väitettä.
